# livekit_webhook_events (Data Source)

The event names a project's webhooks can filter on, for `livekit_webhook`'s `include_events` and `exclude_events`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "livekit_webhook_events" "all" {}

# Every event but track events.
resource "livekit_webhook" "rooms" {
  url = "https://api.example.com/livekit/webhook"
  include_events = [
    for e in data.livekit_webhook_events.all.events : e if !startswith(e, "track_")
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`). Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `events` (List of String) Event names, such as `room_started`, in the API's order.
